group: Facilities Committee - November 15, 2019 - Jody London, Chairperson
title: General Services Agreement – Eide Bailly, LLP - 2017-2018 Audit Facilities Bond Fund Programs and Account Groups - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 1920-0043, Award of General Services Agreement  on behalf of the District to Eide Bailly, LLP*, Oakland, CA, for the latter to perform the 2017-18 Fiscal Year of all capital bond fund programs and related account groups under the jurisdiction the District, aka  Facilities Planning & Management Financial & Performance Bond Audit Project, in the amount of $18,000.00, as the selected consultant and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Agreement for same with said consultant with work scheduled to commence on December 12, 2019, and scheduled to last April 30, 2020, pursuant to the Agreement.  
*Consultant was selected based on demonstrated competence and professional qualifications (Government Code Section 4526)
headline: Hires Eide Bailly for $18,000 to audit 2017-18 school construction bond spending
summary: The district is hiring the accounting firm Eide Bailly, LLP to audit the 2017-18 finances and performance of its construction bond funds, which are overseen by the Facilities Planning and Management division. The contract is for $18,000 and is paid from Measure J bond money. The firm was chosen for its qualifications rather than on price, and work is scheduled to run from December 12, 2019 to April 30, 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Grant Agreement - Oakland Public Education Fund - Educate78 - Bridges Academy
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Grant Agreement between the District and the Oakland Public Education Fund, accepting for the latter $72,000.00, in Educate78 Funding, for third year implementation of 3-Year School Transformation Plan, as described in Section 2 of Agreement,  at Bridges Academy, for the period of October 1, 2019 through June 5, 2020.
headline: Accepts $72,000 from Oakland Public Education Fund for Bridges Academy's school transformation plan
summary: The district is accepting a $72,000 grant, funded by Educate78 and passed through the Oakland Public Education Fund. The money supports the third year of Bridges Academy's three-year School Transformation Plan. The grant period runs from October 1, 2019 to June 5, 2020, which began before the board's vote.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Career Technical Education Facilities Program Projects and Applications - High School Linked Learning Office

title: First Amendment to Ground Lease - City of Oakland - Sobrante Park
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of First Amendment to Ground Lease between the District and the City of Oakland, regarding the Recreational Facilities Sobrante Park, located at 470 El Paseo Drive, Oakland, CA, modifying the Ground Lease to carry out the improvements of the proposed Community-led Renovation of Sobrante Mini Park (the “Renovation Project”), in accordance with the terms and conditions contained herein, including but not limited to extending the time of the Lease commencing on the date on which the Board of Education executes this Agreement and shall continue for a period of thirty (30) years, until 2049, with City granted one option to renew for an additional 30 years. All other terms and conditions of the Ground Lease remain in full force and effect.
headline: Extends City of Oakland's Sobrante Park land lease 30 years to 2049 for park renovation
summary: The district is amending its ground lease with the City of Oakland for the recreation site at 470 El Paseo Drive so the city can carry out a community-led renovation of Sobrante Mini Park. The lease would run for 30 years from the date the board signs it, until 2049, and the city would have one option to renew for another 30 years. The text states no dollar amount, and all other lease terms stay the same.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Measure N Commission - Carryover 2018-2019 Measure N Fund Balances - David Kakishiba, Chairperson, Measure N Commission
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 1920-0175 - Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission Recommendation of Approval of the Carryover of Measure N 2018-2019 Fiscal Year Fund Balance and Plan for Each Named School.
headline: Approves carrying over unspent 2018-19 Measure N college and career funds for each named school
summary: This resolution adopts the Measure N commission's recommendation to carry over the unspent 2018-19 Measure N fund balance, along with a plan for each named school. Measure N supports college and career readiness programs. The text gives no dollar amounts.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
